textEvidence.text: The Bistro Butcher has a mandatory, non-targeting monster effect after it inflicts positive battle damage on the opponent, including as defender. The opponent draws two cards. Prevented damage and damage merely caused by another card do not qualify. If battle damage ends the duel, no later trigger resolves.

Masked Sorcerer has a mandatory, non-targeting monster effect after it inflicts positive battle damage on the opponent, including as defender. Its controller draws one card. Prevented damage and damage merely caused by another card do not qualify. If battle damage ends the duel, no later trigger resolves.

textEvidence.text: White Magical Hat has a mandatory, non-targeting monster effect after it inflicts positive battle damage on the opponent, including as defender. textEvidence.text: Airknight Parshath has a mandatory, non-targeting monster effect after it inflicts positive battle damage on the opponent, including as defender. Its controller draws one card. It also inflicts piercing battle damage when attacking a Defense Position monster. Prevented damage and damage merely caused by another card do not qualify. If battle damage ends the duel, no later trigger resolves.

card.name: Samurai Sasuke nº 3

textEvidence.text: Sasuke Samurai #3 has a mandatory, non-targeting monster effect after it inflicts positive battle damage on the opponent, including as defender. The opponent draws only the number needed to reach seven cards; if at seven or more they do not draw. Prevented damage and damage merely caused by another card do not qualify. If battle damage ends the duel, no later trigger resolves.
